issues.title: `shop report daily` counts an order of the next day
issues.body:
`python3 -m shop report daily 2026-11-20` on the sample data prints `2026-11-20: 3 orders, revenue $87.17`. Only orders 1001 and 1002 were placed on 2026-11-20. Order 1003 was placed at `2026-11-21T00:00:00Z`, and the report of 2026-11-21 counts it too. I think the daily report in `shop/services/reports.py` selects the wrong orders.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `python3 -m shop report daily 2026-11-20` on the sample data prints `2026-11-20: 2 orders, revenue $66.17`.
- [ ] An order placed at exactly `00:00:00Z` counts only in the report of the day that starts at that time.
- [ ] `GET /orders?date=<day>` lists only the orders placed on that UTC day, with the same rule at midnight.
